title: fix(metadata-protocol,rest,runtime)!: a name only disabled packages hold answers 404 at `_env`, and its package-less customization is withheld (ADR-0150 D3, D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBePzY6g11h3hyWk5ud4vWy)_

Fixes #33385
Fixes #33401

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here — content/docs/data-modeling/import-mappings.mdx (no `skills/**` file teaches an `_env` answer)

**BREAKING** for a read of an environment customization (a package-less row) of a name whose every holding package is disabled: the bare read and the execution read answered the row (200) and now answer 404 as if it were not saved; re-enabling the package serves it again. `_env` of such a name moves from 409 naming the disabled packages to 404, at `/meta` on both transports and at the import door's `mappingName: "_env/NAME"` (`404 MAPPING_NOT_FOUND`). The list and the execution list (`GET /meta/:type`) leave out the same customization while every holder is disabled, so they agree with the read of the name. On the write side, a save naming no package at a member the holder never ships is still accepted and kept, but is hidden from those reads until a holder is enabled again; a delete still removes it; a save at a shipped member is still refused `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`. `_env` keeps the 409 in three cases: an enabled package holds the name; it holds it through a stored row the read of the name serves; or the read carries `?state=draft` / `?preview=draft` from a caller admitted to drafts, or `?layers=`. That 409 names only the disabled registry holder. No migration: nothing stored changes (ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, in the changeset).

The claim declared `Clause-②: no`. The declaration self-check reads the #33401 withhold (served 200 to 404) as a narrowing and finds no widening: the `_env` move replaces one refusal with another. So this body and the changeset declare `no (narrowing)`. #33646's `yes (narrowing)` was for a diff that both widened and narrowed. The deviation is reported to the seat.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:某个元数据名称的所有持有包都被停用时,`/meta/:type/_env/:name` 在两个入口(REST 与 runtime)从 409(点名被停用的包)改为 404,导入接口的 `mappingName: "_env/名称"` 同样改为 404 `MAPPING_NOT_FOUND`;环境里对这些包的名称做的无包定制(含包从未发布的语言版本)在停用期间不再被读出,列表与执行列表也一并不再列出,重新启用后原样恢复。
- **为什么改**:停用包是运维处理冲突的常规手段,但 `_env` 仍然报冲突并点名已停用的包,裸读还在返回属于已停用包的定制内容;#32183 第 17 行(R4-B2)与 #32814 的席位裁决要求按"什么都没存"作答。
- **风险与回滚**:只改读路径判定,不删数据;若某个启用包只通过未水合的存储行持有该名称,`_env` 仍保持 main 的 409;带 `?state=draft`、`?preview=draft` 或 `?layers=` 的 `_env` 读取也保持 409,不会露出启用包的草稿(均已钉住并做消融)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts`(`packagelessRowWithheld`:启用包通过存储行持有名称时不再扣留,风险最高)、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`(列表按同一判定剔除)、`packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.ts`(`admitEnvironmentAddress`:标记的拒绝只对普通读取与无草稿权限的调用方放行为 404)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts`,预期 381 个测试全部通过(在 `0f5f95d0` 实测)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

One judgment, shared by both cards: a name whose every holder is disabled answers as if nothing were stored. That covers the bare read (served and execution faces), its `/layers`, and `_env` on both transports. A disabled package's customization is never served, and nothing stored is touched.

- **#33401**, `protocol-meta-item-face.ts`: the read naming no package now also withholds a **package-less** row it reached when the row's key is held only by disabled packages (`packagelessRowWithheldHolder`). The key's holders come from the registry's one owner rule, `overlayRowBinding` with every holder counted (seat ruling 6882483833 on #32814: ownership counts every holder, disabled included).
  - `null` is the environment's own item (D3 (a)) and is served.
  - One holder: withheld when that holder is disabled.
  - Two or more: judged as the name's holders are (`disabledOnlyHolderOf`).
  - Member grain is not part of the key, so a locale the holder never shipped is withheld too.
- **#33385**: `admitEnvironmentQualifier` (`protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`) still refuses a name only disabled packages hold. It is synchronous, it reads no stored rows, and its declared signature lives in `protocol.ts`. The refusal now carries a registered-symbol mark (`objectstack.metadata-protocol.disabledHoldersOnlyRefusal`, the same pattern as the face's `storedRowHoldersRefusal`), set only after the read it would admit has passed the 501 judgment.
  - Each `_env` door handles the mark in `admitEnvironmentAddress`: `packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`.
  - If the read naming no package (`getMetaItem`) withholds the name, the door admits `_env`, and the read answers 404 naming no package.
  - If that read serves an item, or refuses, an enabled package holds the name through a stored row the registry has not read, and the 409 stands, as on main.
  - Review S1: only the read that judged the name is admitted this way. The marked 409 stands, as on main, for exactly three reads, which read other rows than the plain read: `?state=draft` (any case) and `?preview=draft` from a caller `mayReadPendingDrafts` admits to drafts, and the deprecated layered view `?layers=`. A caller who may not read drafts reads the active rows whatever switch it sends, so its draft switch is judged as the plain read (404), on both transports alike. REST asks `resolveExecCtx` for that admission, which is why `rest-server.ts` hands the qualified route its `resolveExecCtx` (deviation, approved by the area seat).
- Review S2, `packages/rest/src/import-mapping.ts#namedMappingRead`: the import door's `_env/NAME` reads the same mark and admits it the same way. A mapping only disabled packages hold answers `404 MAPPING_NOT_FOUND`, naming no package, as `GET /meta/mapping/_env/NAME` answers 404.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/import-mappings.mdx` documents the new 404 (review S3).
- Review#2 S1, `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts#readFlattenedMetaItems` (file approved by the area seat): the list and the execution list now leave out a package-less item that the read of its name withholds, through the same `packagelessRowWithheld`. Before, both lists still carried an `fr-FR` row the by-name read answered 404.
- Review#2 S5, `protocol-meta-item-face.ts#packagelessRowWithheld`: the arm is judged over the active rows the face already read. If an enabled package holds the name through one of those stored rows (one the registry has not hydrated, so `overlayRowBinding` does not see it), the package-less row is served, as on main. Before this fix the arm withheld it in that cell. The list asks the same helper, which reads the active rows itself.
- Review#2 S4: the residual 409 names only the disabled registry holder, `[{ kind: 'package', packageId: B }]`, as on main; the enabled package holding the name through a stored row is not named. Pinned in both doors' CONTROLs.
- Review#2 S3, measured: with every holder disabled, a save naming no package at a member the package never ships is accepted and kept, as on main, and is now hidden until a holder is enabled again; a delete of it removes the row; a save at a shipped member is refused `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, as before. Pinned in `disabled-holder-packageless-row-doors.test.ts`.
- `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`: read only. H3 holds: `overlaySlotBinding` counts every composite holder, so a package-less row of a disabled holder's key binds to that holder, and `getEnvironmentScopedItem` answers `undefined` for it.
- The PM's H2 was half true. Without a mark, the `_env` read never reached the face as `_env`. Admitting on the registry alone would have served an enabled package's unhydrated stored row at `_env`. The mark plus the door's bare-read check closes that without touching `protocol.ts`.

| Read | State | FROM (origin/main 1e65a389, measured) | TO |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `GET /meta/:type/_env/:name`, REST and runtime, all 18 `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` | only holder disabled, no row | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming the disabled holder | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, naming no package |
| same | only holder disabled, a package-less registry row of the name | 409 naming it | 404 |
| same, `dashboard` `email_template` `permission` `report` | only registry holder disabled, an enabled package's unhydrated stored row the bare read serves | 409 | 409 (unchanged, CONTROL) |
| same, the other 14 types | same fixture; their bare read serves no row of that shape | 409 | 404, as their bare read |
| protocol `admitEnvironmentQualifier` (objectql pin, row 17) | the only holder disabled | 409 naming X | 409 naming X, marked; the bare read withholds, so both doors answer 404 |
| bare `GET /meta/email_template/:name?member=fr-FR` and the execution read | the only holder disabled, a package-less stored row of a locale it never shipped (stored, or stored and hydrated), both registration orders, disabled before or after | 200, the row | the holder's withheld item (404), equal to the answer with no row stored |
| same | two holders, both disabled | 200, the row | withheld |
| `_env`, bare read | the holder re-enabled | 409 naming it / the row | unchanged |
| `_env` with `?state=draft` (any case) or `?preview=draft`, REST and runtime, all 18 types | only registry holder disabled, an enabled package's draft row only | 409 | 409 (unchanged, CONTROL, review S1) |
| `_env` with `?layers=true`, same | only registry holder disabled, an enabled package's unhydrated active row | 409 | 409 (unchanged, CONTROL, review S1) |
| import `POST …/import` with `mappingName: "_env/NAME"` | the only holder of the mapping disabled | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming it | 404 `MAPPING_NOT_FOUND`, naming no package; nothing written |
| same | the holder re-enabled | 409 naming it | unchanged (CONTROL) |
| bare read, `/layers` | package-less row at a member the holder ships | 404 | 404 (unchanged, CONTROL) |
| `_env`, protocol `admitEnvironmentQualifier` (review L2 N3) | the only holder disabled, on an engine whose registry has no package-scoped resolver for the type (no by-name reads; not a production composition) | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming the holder | 501 `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, the read that engine cannot judge (refusal to refusal) |
| bare `GET /meta/action/:name` (objectql pin, review L2 S1), both registration orders | the only holder disabled, ships the action on `account`; a package-less action of the name on `contact` | served (`main` since #33898; measured here with the arm ablated) | served, the environment's own item, no `_packageId` (unchanged, CONTROL); re-enabled, the same |
| same | same, the package-less action on `account` | withheld (the stamped-item rules) | withheld (unchanged, CONTROL); re-enabled, served under the holder's envelope |
| `_env` with a draft switch from a caller who may not read drafts, REST and runtime, all 18 types | only registry holder disabled | 409 | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, as its plain read (both transports agree) |
| `getMetaItems` / `getMetaItemsForExecution` (list, execution list) | the only holder disabled, a package-less row at a never-shipped locale (saved after boot, or hydrated at boot) | the row listed | not listed; re-enabled, listed again (CONTROL) |
| bare read and both lists, either order | X's registry holder disabled, enabled Y holds the name through an unhydrated stored row, a package-less row | served and listed | unchanged (CONTROL, review#2 S5); `_env` keeps the marked 409 |
| save / delete naming no package | every holder disabled; never-shipped member / shipped member | saved and served / 403 | saved and hidden until re-enable, delete removes it / 403 (unchanged) |

The served-to-404 rows are narrowings (hence `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, the `!` title and the BREAKING banner). The `_env` rows, and the import door's, replace one refusal with another (409 to 404). No answer widens.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` (the face's shared real-registry harness; the area seat approved this file-surface extension):
  - The R4-B2 `_env` pin now asserts the marked 409 plus the withheld bare read. An unmarked-with-the-holder-enabled CONTROL is added beside it.
  - New top-level `[#33401]` describe, the bare read at a never-shipped locale: four orders on both faces with re-enable as CONTROL; the answer with the row stored equals the answer with none; two holders both disabled, then both re-enabled giving the read's own 409; the hydrated row.
  - CONTROLs: an enabled holder, the environment's own item, and a row at a shipped member.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`, for every `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` type:
  - `_env` answers 404 beside the other addresses' 404; re-enabled, the 409 naming the holder (CONTROL).
  - A package-less registry row: the bare read, `/layers` and `_env` answer 404; re-enabled, the 409.
  - The unhydrated stored-row CONTROL, with the four row-serving types named explicitly so its 409 leg cannot pass vacuously.
  - Review S1 CONTROL: with an enabled package's draft row only, `_env` with `?state=draft`, `?state=DRAFT` and `?preview=draft` answers 409 and never the draft. With its unhydrated active row, `_env?layers=true` answers 409 and never the row.
  - Review S1 draft-switch cell: a member caller who may not read drafts sends `?state=draft`, and both transports answer 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, the same answer.
  - Review#2 S4: the standing 409's `details.candidates` is exactly `[{ kind: 'package', packageId: B }]`, the disabled registry holder, in the draft/layered CONTROL and the row-holder CONTROL, on both transports.
  - Both harnesses' engine doubles now answer `find` from stored rows (empty unless a pin stores one); `findOne` stays main's `null`.
- `packages/rest/src/import-integration.test.ts` (review S2, real engine and protocol): with the only holder disabled, `_env/task_pkg_feed` answers 404 `MAPPING_NOT_FOUND` naming no package, `GET /meta/mapping/_env/task_pkg_feed` answers 404, and no row is written. Re-enabled, the 409 naming the holder (CONTROL).
- New `packages/objectql/src/disabled-holder-packageless-row-doors.test.ts` (real ObjectQL engine, in-memory driver, real protocol; 5 tests):
  - Review#2 S1: a package-less `fr-FR` row, saved after boot or hydrated at boot, with the only holder disabled: the by-name read withholds it and neither list nor execution list carries any item of the name. Re-enabled, both list `en-US`, `fr-FR`, `zh-CN` (CONTROL).
  - Review#2 S3: with the holder disabled, a save naming no package at `fr-FR` succeeds and keeps one package-less row, the read and both lists hide it, a save at shipped `en-US` is refused `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`; re-enabled it is served; a delete while disabled removes the row.
  - Review#2 S5, both orders (the by-name read first, the list first): X disabled, enabled Y holding the name through an unhydrated stored row, a package-less `fr-FR` row. The read serves `ENV fr` at `fr-FR` and Y's `OTHER en` bare, both lists carry `fr-FR`, as on main; `admitEnvironmentQualifier` still throws the marked 409.
- Review L2 S1, `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` `[review L2 S1]` (4 tests): the action legs above, each in both registration orders, with re-enable as CONTROL.
- Ablations: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --hold`. Each mutate leg on metadata-protocol was rebuilt and `ablation-dist-preflight` returned 0; each restore leg was rebuilt, `--absent` returned 0, and the restore was proved blob == HEAD.
  - #33401 arm removed (at 71880ceb, face unchanged since): objectql 7 red of 319, all seven moved cells; every CONTROL green.
  - The mark removed: objectql 1 red of 320, the row 17 pin. rest 50 red of 353 and runtime 50 red of 363: 18 types times 2 404-pins, plus the 14 non-row-serving types' 404 leg.
  - The door's withheld check removed: rest 4 red of 353 and runtime 4 red of 363, exactly the four row-serving types' 409 CONTROL.
  - Review S1, the plain-read guard removed (`ablation-replace --delete`; the mutation landed, and the restore matched the HEAD blob): rest 18 red of 371 and runtime 18 red of 381, one per type. In these harnesses `findOne` answers `null`, so the ablated door answers `404 NO_DRAFT`.
  - A one-time probe (not committed) gave the doubles a row-serving `findOne`:
    - Without the guard, both transports answered `200` with the enabled package's draft for all 18 types. This is the widening review S1 describes.
    - With the guard, both stayed green.
    - With only the `?layers=` arm removed, 14 types on each transport answered `_env?layers=true` with `404` instead of `409`. That swaps one refusal for another; it does not widen. The guard keeps main's 409.
  - Review S1 admission (the draft-switch judgment), the caller's admission ignored so every draft switch keeps the refusal: rest 18 red of 371 and runtime 18 red of 381, the member-caller cell for each type.
  - Review#2 S5, at `69f48871`: `enabledRowHolds(...) ? undefined :` replaced so the arm always withholds; rebuilt, preflight marker in 2 dist files. objectql 2 red of 330, exactly the two S5 orders. Restore: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, `--absent` exit 0.
  - Review#2 S1, at `69f48871`: the list's `packagelessRowWithheld` call replaced by a never-true marker; rebuilt, preflight in 2 dist files. objectql 3 red of 330: both S1 cells and the S3 test's list assertion. Restore proved the same way.
  - Review L2 S1, after the merge of `main`, at `8bbac030` (test text as committed; the later amend changed only its comment), objectql 342 tests:
    - The arm removed (`packagelessRowWithheld` never withholds): 10 red, every `[#33401]` withhold cell and the lists; both action legs stay green.
    - The arm's binding-`null` exemption replaced by the name's holders (`disabledOnlyHolderOf`): 2 red, exactly the two other-object action cells.
    - The face's stamped-item rules removed together (`isActionWithheldByDisabledPackage`, `isItemOfDisabledPackage`): 4 red, the two same-object action cells and the two shipped-member CONTROLs. With `isItemOfDisabledPackage` alone removed, only those two CONTROLs went red.
    - Each mutate leg was rebuilt with `ablation-dist-preflight` exit 0. Each restore was proved by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`, then rebuilt with `--absent` exit 0.
  - Review S2, the import door's mark check replaced by a bare rethrow: 1 red of 61 in `import-integration.test.ts`, the new pin; the 409 naming the holder came back.

## Acceptance notes

- **Correction (review L2 S1):** an earlier body said the card's action CONTROL, "a same-name item on another object is still served", was unreachable. That was true of this branch's old base and false of `main` since 68e726d6 (#33898), which grafts an action's envelope only onto the item its package holds at that `(object, name)`. The branch now merges `main` (`35cc6638`), and both legs are pinned under a disabled holder, in both registration orders: on another object (`contact`) the package-less action binds to no holder (`overlayRowBinding` answers `null`) and is served as the environment's own item, with no `_packageId`; on the holder's own object (`account`) it is the holder's customization under its envelope and is withheld; re-enabled, both are served. Measured by ablation: the new arm reaches the other-object leg and its binding-`null` exemption keeps it served, as on `main`; the same-object leg is decided by the face's stamped-item rules (`isActionWithheldByDisabledPackage`, `isItemOfDisabledPackage`), as on `main`, because the read reaches the face with the holder's envelope already grafted.
- The `_env` door asks the bare read once more before it answers a marked refusal. That costs one extra protocol read, and only on the disabled-only path. The list asks `packagelessRowWithheld` per package-less item only when a disabled holder is in play, and that reads the item's active rows.
- **Loose end (review#2 S4), carried by #34261:** the draft and layered `_env` reads keep main's 409 here; whether they should also answer 404 when every holder is disabled is the follow-up. PR #34169 (`claude/area-E1-32849-layered`), which touched the face and both shared test harnesses, has merged and is inside the merged `main`.
- **CI note:** Test Core (3/8) was red at `d86adb40` (run 43751883003) on `@objectstack/scenarios` `test/runner/run-date.test.ts` timing out on run date 2028-03-31, the known flake #34081. This diff does not touch `@objectstack/scenarios`.

- **Follow-ups, left unfixed; the area filed them:**
  - #34258: the action withhold at the key's grain (review-c N1, review#2 N1; review L2 N1: with two or more holders on the row's key, `disabledOnlyHolderOf` judges the name's holders, not the key's).
  - #34259: the unpinned cells and the list memo (review-c N2/N5, review#2 N2 to N5; review L2 N2 and N5). Triage closed it `not_planned` under the maintainer's p3 standard (no user effect), so these cells are an accepted deviation: unpinned, each held by reading as the reviews state. Reopen it if a regression appears.
  - #34260: an ADR-0150 addendum for "a disabled package holds no name", and the `PATCH /packages/:id/disable` docs (review L2 N4).
  - #34261: the draft and layered `_env` 409 (the review#2 S4 loose end above).
  - #34262: the accepted save that stays hidden while every holder is disabled.

### Deviations

- `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`: the qualified route's host object now hands it `resolveExecCtx`, on its own line as every registrar host spells it (`execctx-consumer-census` unchanged). Outside the claimed surface; approved by the area seat.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`: the list filter (review#2 S1). Approved by the area seat for this.
- `packages/objectql/src/disabled-holder-packageless-row-doors.test.ts`: a new test file for the review#2 S1/S3/S5 pins, on a real ObjectQL engine and protocol.
